title: Can a Pill Take Share from Injectables? The ICOTYDE Commercial Test
summary: ICOTYDE generated more than 18,000 prescriptions in its first full quarter, showing demand for an oral IL-23R peptide. Valuation now depends on paid scripts, persistence, payer quality, and success beyond psoriasis.
source_status: English website adaptation synchronized to the 2026-07-19 PASS Facebook/Dcard longform; public CMoney readback retained as publication evidence
cover_image_alt: An oral IL-23R peptide, psoriatic skin, and an injectable biologic define the ICOTYDE commercial contest
homepage_cover_image_alt: ICOTYDE brings a once-daily oral peptide into competition with injectable psoriasis therapies
core_judgments: ICOTYDE has moved oral psoriasis therapy into a high-efficacy competitive tier, but launch momentum must convert into paid prescriptions and persistence before it becomes commercial proof.
The 84% week-52 PASI 90 maintenance figure applies only to adult week-24 PASI 90 responders rerandomized to continue therapy, not to every treated patient.
The more-than-$5-billion potential depends on psoriatic arthritis, ulcerative colitis, and Crohn's disease, so a multi-indication expectation should not be capitalized all at once.
